digest.component_or_area: CLI read surfaces (show, list, search, ready) / reconverge lock path
propositions: Read CLI surfaces (show, list, search, ready) share the reconverge lock path via ensure_fresh and must maintain output integrity under concurrent background-push write storms.
Under high write contention, reads can return exit 0 with empty/truncated stdout instead of valid JSON, a regression affecting all surfaces that routed through the same lock.
The ed2b property test harness (repo_with_origin_tickets + _rebar_cli + throttle clearing) must be generalized and parameterized across all read surfaces to prevent silent per-surface regressions.
Each read invocation must clear the sync throttle marker before executing so the reconverge path is exercised rather than short-circuited to the local snapshot.

For JSON output modes, exit 0 must guarantee parseable output matching the surface's documented shape (dict for show; list for list/search/ready); valid-empty [] is acceptable, truncated-empty is not.
